simple.meaning: סָרִיס (çârîyç) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a eunuch ; by implication, valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus, a minister of state.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 42 times across Genesis, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 37:36. Its contexts include family line, kingship, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָרִיס (H5631).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סָרִיס (çârîyç) / H5631 is traced through Genesis 37:36, Genesis 39:1, Genesis 40:2, Genesis 40:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a eunuch ; by implication, valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus, a minister of state
definitions.full: H5631. saris סָרִיס 45 noun masculine eunuch (Late Hebrew id. , סָרִיסָא ᵑ7 , Syriac (all with verb denominative = emasculate ), Old Aramaic סרסא Lzb 331 Cook 86 ; Arabic , (verb be impotent ), Kam Frey (not Lane); probably foreign word; according to Jen ZA vii. 174 = Assyrian šarêši ( rîši ), he who is the head, chief , compare Brock Lex 239 b Dl HWB 694 ( ša-riš ?), Zim ZMG liii. 1899, 116 ; eunuch being specialized meaning; in any case Arabic is Aramaic loan-word); — absolute ׳ס 1Kin 22:9 7 t.; construct סְרִיס Gen 37:36 3 t.; plural סָרִיסִים 2Kin 9:32 17 t.; construct סְרִיסֵי Gen 40:7 4 t.; suffix סָרִיסָיו 40:2 4 t., סָרִיסֶ֫יהָ Est 4:4 ; — eunuch , of Pharaoh Gen 37:36 ; 40:2 , 7 (all E), married 39:1 (R JE ); of Israel kings 1Sam 8:15 (predict.), 1Kin 22:9 2Chr 18:8 ; 2Kin 8:6 ; 9:32 (all of Northern Israel); 1Chr 28:1 (in David's time). 2Kin 23:11 ; 24:12 , 15 compare Jer 29:2 , also 34:19 ; 38:7 ; 41:16 (all in Judah; so likewise) 2Kin 25:19 (military officer) = Jer 52:25 ; of Babylonian kings 2Kin 20:18 = Isa 39:7 (predict.); ascribed to Nebuchadnezzar in Daniel, סָרִיסָיו רַב Dan 1:3 , הַסָּרִיסִים שַׂר 1:7 ; 1:8 ; 1:9 ; 1:10 ; 1:11 ; 1:18 ; to king of Persia in Est 1:10 , 12 , 15 9 t. Esther; promises made to eunuchs Isa 56:3-4 ,. (Term never used in law codes; on contrary compare exclusion of דַּכָּא מְּצוּעַ , and שָׁפְכָה כְּרוּת Deut 23:2 [see Dr on the passage ], also אָ֑שֶׁךְ מְרוֺחַ Lev 21:20 .) — רַבסָֿרִיס is title of high military officer 2Kin 18:17 (Assyrian ), Jer 39:3 , 13 (Babylonian ). — See further, Thes Smith DB Art.
